dataset.name: RipVIS
dataset.sequence_policy: Ordered labelled samples are divided where the source-frame gap exceeds 6; smoothing and consecutive-mask metrics never cross a segment boundary. The window counts labelled samples, not elapsed time.

coordinate_alignment.reason: Stabilised predictions cannot be compared with unwarped source masks. Motion estimates are used only for adaptive temporal weighting.

motion_evidence.method: ORB partial-affine motion estimated between ordered sampled frames
motion_evidence.coordinate_policy: Motion metadata controls temporal weights; predictions remain in source-frame coordinates for comparison with source-aligned ground truth.
